title: Returns Reason Capture
description: A short, structured form customers fill in when starting a return, capturing exactly why the item is going back (size, colour, fabric, style, quality) instead of a vague free-text box.
problem_solved: Owners currently see returns as a cost line with no visibility into why items come back, so they cannot fix the sizing, description, or quality issues actually driving returns.
roi_evidence: UK apparel e-commerce returns rates average around 20-27% of orders

title: Abandoned Cart Recovery Emails
description: A three-email sequence automatically sent to shoppers who add items to their cart but leave without checking out, reminding them and nudging them back to complete the purchase.
problem_solved: The business loses revenue from shoppers who show clear buying intent but drop off before checkout, with no follow-up to bring them back.
roi_evidence: Abandoned cart email flows recover roughly 3-5% of total attributed revenue for Klaviyo-connected stores

title: AI Product Description Writing
description: Using an AI writing tool to generate first-draft product descriptions from a photo and a few bullet points, then having a human lightly edit before publishing.
problem_solved: Writing on-brand product copy for every SKU and variant is slow, and small teams fall behind on new-arrival listings.
roi_evidence: Generative AI writing assistance cut content-drafting time by roughly 40-60% for early-adopter marketing teams
roi_source: McKinsey Global Survey on the State of AI, 2023

title: Automated Review Collection
description: An automated post-purchase email or SMS sequence that asks customers to leave a photo review, timed to arrive once the item has likely been worn.
problem_solved: The business relies on customers volunteering reviews unprompted, so review volume stays low and social proof on product pages is thin.
roi_evidence: Automated post-purchase review requests generate roughly 3-5x more reviews than passive collection alone
roi_source: Yotpo State of Ecommerce CX Report 2023

title: Size Guide Chatbot
description: A conversational size-recommendation assistant that asks a shopper a few quick questions about fit preference and body measurements, then suggests the right size for a given garment.
problem_solved: Shoppers guess their size without reliable guidance, driving size-related returns and eroding confidence in ordering online.
roi_evidence: Fit-recommendation tools have been shown to reduce size-related returns by up to 25% for participating retailers
roi_source: Fit Analytics (Snap Inc.) retailer case studies, 2022

title: Email Marketing Automation Flows
description: A full set of lifecycle email flows — welcome series, win-back, post-purchase, browse abandonment — built on top of the store's existing customer and order data.
problem_solved: The business sends one-off campaigns manually but has no always-on lifecycle marketing capturing revenue from existing subscribers and customers.
roi_evidence: Email marketing continues to deliver among the highest returns of any digital channel, commonly cited around £36-42 return per £1 spent
roi_source: Data & Marketing Association (DMA) Marketer Email Tracker 2023

title: WhatsApp Styling Assistant
description: A WhatsApp-based conversational assistant that answers styling questions, recommends outfits, and helps customers complete a purchase without leaving the chat.
problem_solved: Customers ask styling and product questions over social DMs and WhatsApp that currently go unanswered outside business hours, losing sales.
roi_evidence: 78% of businesses surveyed said messaging with customers on WhatsApp helped them close a sale
roi_source: Meta Conversational Commerce Report, commissioned research 2022

title: AI Demand Forecasting
description: A forecasting model that uses historical sales, seasonality, and trend signals to predict how much of each style, colour, and size to buy for the next season.
problem_solved: Buying decisions rely on gut feel and spreadsheets, leading to stockouts on bestsellers and overstock that ends up discounted.
roi_evidence: AI-enabled demand forecasting has been shown to reduce forecasting errors by 20-50% and cut lost sales from stockouts
roi_source: McKinsey "Succeeding in the AI supply-chain revolution" report, 2023

title: Personalised Outfit Recommender
description: A recommendation engine that suggests complete outfits and cross-sell items to each shopper based on their browsing and purchase history.
problem_solved: Every customer sees the same generic product grid regardless of their taste or past purchases, missing opportunities to increase basket size.
roi_evidence: Companies that excel at personalisation generate 40% more revenue from those activities than average players
roi_source: McKinsey "The value of getting personalization right" report, 2021

title: Dynamic Pricing Engine
description: A pricing system that automatically adjusts discounts and markdowns across the catalog based on sell-through rate, stock levels, and competitor pricing.
problem_solved: Markdown decisions are made manually and reactively at end of season, leaving margin on the table earlier and excess stock later.
roi_evidence: Retailers using dynamic and AI-assisted pricing have reported gross margin improvements in the range of 2-5 percentage points
roi_source: McKinsey "Setting the right prices" retail pricing analysis, 2022
